items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they said even Benny back in the early days with Pollack was like that too

ctx.x: It had a great bandstand and good sounding room. Lotta bands, bands played there all the times in the 20s, I think Ben Pollack was there with Benny Goodman and the band, Jack Teagarden. It was, it was a real good band spot. And we’d go to the New Yorker and hear bands, I heard Benny Goodman there, heard Tommy Dorsey up at the Astor Roof later. You know there were just a, and I’d go hear them at all the stage shows, the Paramount changed every few weeks, the Strand changed every two weeks, every few weeks. I’d go…
